title: Why was my Green Account (checking) transaction declined?
summary: This document lists common causes of a declined Green Account (checking) transaction: amount exceeded available balance, pending card holds reducing available balance, or the merchant submitting a higher final amount than the estimate. It also explains how to confirm via decline notifications/alerts and how to resolve by adding funds or asking the merchant to confirm the authorization amount.
